title: Plumeform (v2)
description: Warm off-white paper and deep green-black bands lit by teal glass. Ink headings in a tight geometric grotesk, slate body, plume-teal toggles and underlines, mint PRO badges, and pastel fog (sky, peach, butter, mint) around light glass panels. Pills, 28px cards, 20px panels.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the plumeform-v2 dark bands force themselves dark with the dark class
chart-3, chart-4 and chart-5 are the pastel fog colours (sky, peach, butter) used by plumeform-v2-panel
Manrope is the original's own face (OFL)
name: plumeform-v2-theme
